svg.title: Particula fits the measured rise in particle number with sulfur dioxide in a straw-combustion analogue
svg.desc: Measured and fitted two-path outlet counts at 0, 50 and 500 ppm sulfur dioxide. The measurements rise from 3.0 to 14.7 to 29.2 million particles per cm³. Particula gives 5.2, 12.3 and 27.8 million per cm³.
